options.name: Controlled L4 GCE/Vertex runtime for SGLang
options.description: Move SGLang import-smoke/generated-runtime to a controlled GCE, Vertex, or custom job environment with a reviewed NVIDIA driver/CUDA stack while keeping the L4 GPU class.
options.recommendation: Possible fallback only with explicit human approval.

options.name: Human-approved VLM QA redesign
options.description: Keep Qwen/vLLM as advisory label/uncertainty signal only; use OCR, OpenCV, and media-data outputs as authoritative geometry and safe-zone sources.
pros: reduces dependence on brittle VLM localization
can move beta readiness through deterministic tools
cons: may not satisfy a requirement that VLM owns localization
options.recommendation: Default product-forward VLM recovery posture unless VLM-owned localization is mandatory.

options.name: Non-Qwen VLM candidate approval
options.description: Start a new approval chain for a non-Qwen VLM candidate optimized for generated-image grounding and L4/runtime fit.
pros: cleaner than forcing current Qwen candidates
options.recommendation: Valid only if product explicitly requires VLM-owned perception/localization.

options.name: Different approved GPU/runtime CUDA class
options.description: Approve a GPU/runtime environment with newer driver/CUDA support, such as RTX PRO 6000 on Cloud Run if available or another approved GPU platform.
pros: may run larger or more capable models
cons: still may not solve semantic QA
options.recommendation: Not default; use only if budget/runtime approval exists.

options.name: Continue current Cloud Run L4 SGLang kernel work
options.description: Keep trying package/source-build combinations on Cloud Run L4.
options.recommendation: Stop unless there is a specific new upstream fix/version with strong evidence.

options.name: Pause VLM and continue Phase 46A media/data hardening
options.description: Keep VLM blocked and continue with deterministic media/data tool audit and fixture suite.
options.recommendation: Immediate next implementation phase unless a human explicitly approves Option A, C, D, or E.
